LightningComponentBundle.description: Chat with an Archon AI agent — drop on record pages, app/home pages, the utility bar, or open as a tab. On record pages the conversation anchors to the record being viewed.

property.name: agentApiName
property.label: Agent API name
property.description: ApiName__c of the agent to chat with. Leave blank to let the user pick from chat-enabled agents.

property.name: componentHeight
property.label: Height (px)
property.description: Widget height. Utility bar panels usually fit 480–560.
